The collapse of the Soviet Union unleashed a turbulent era in Russia's gas sector. Amid rampant corruption, power grabs, and chaos, Gazprom rose to unprecedented influence. These early wild days shaped the energy landscape and sowed seeds for future geopolitical battles.
